notes: SEO > Catalog Services now has a Language filter - it doesn't hide any rows (the catalog itself has no per-language rows), it switches what the Name/Description/Status columns display: that language's real translated title/description if one exists, the raw pricing-sync text as a fallback if not, and a Status badge (Source / Translated / Pending / Not queued) showing exactly where each service stands for the selected language. Fixes Landing Category matching being unreliable across languages: match_text is now checked ONLY against a service's English and site-default-language category/name (via its Service Translation, falling back to the raw pricing-sync text only if untranslated yet) - never against whatever single language the pricing API's account happens to return. The actual name/description returned to the frontend still follows ?lang= exactly as before. Catalog services matched by an active Landing Category also get automatically translated into every active language via the existing hourly translation queue. The Catalog pricing sync API server (SEO > Settings) is picked from your existing Free Service Gateway > API Servers list instead of typing a separate smm.plus API key/host. Adds a public GET /api/services endpoint (restricted to the smm.plus CORS origin) serving the cached retail catalog (price/min/max, synced daily) filtered by an admin-configured landing-page category slug, with optional geo/lang filtering - for SEO landing pages that currently hardcode pricing. Also corrects the earlier 1.27.30 update, which broke the Analytics page - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
